title: Youth program pages that print two different participant counts
question: On which pages does the enrolment measure's count of participants served differ widely from the participants in the page's own activity table?
finding: 12 program-years differ by 100 or more, or by 30% or more. Largest: Japanese Community Youth Council - Mayor’s Youth Employment and Education Program (2025-26): 1,499 participants, 1,042 served in the measure; Samoan Community Development Center - Pacific Islander Youth Alliance (2025-26): 164 participants, 370 served in the measure; Young Community Developers - Summer Youth Academic and Employment Program (2024-25): 218 participants, 423 served in the measure.
how: The enrolment measure's text carries the count it used, e.g. 'Number of participants served (86) as a percentage of the program's projected number of participants (55)'; it is set against the Participants figure in the Activities table of the same page.
limits: The two counts may follow different rules (a minimum attendance, young people counted in aggregate, one cycle of a program); the pages do not say. Differences run in both directions, which fits a definition difference better than an error.
